subject: Quick pause on the demo — VividHealth redirects LLM effort to roadmap sprint
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Liam Porter <liam.porter@vividhealth.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling a focused 30m demo - proposed times + agenda

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the quick call yesterday. Per our chat, I’ve attached a short demo agenda (30 minutes) and a mutual action plan so we can align on success criteria. Proposed windows next week: Tue 9/14 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 9/15 13:00–13:30 PT. Does either work for you and Asha?

Attachments: 20260910-vividhealth-multi-step-map.xlsx, 20260912-demo-agenda.pdf

Goal for the session: show a tailored inference flow for your triage use case and surface expected latency & cost for a 3k–6k daily request pattern.

If those times don’t work, share a couple that do and I’ll coordinate with Marissa for the technical walk-through.

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Rahman | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189
Redwood Inference — High-performance LLM inference for production
From: Liam Porter <liam.porter@vividhealth.co>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Menon <asha.menon@vividhealth.co>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling a focused 30m demo - proposed times + agenda

Hi Aisha —

Appreciate the materials and the clear agenda. Quick update from our side: leadership just reprioritized the roadmap for the next two sprints to focus on a patient data migration and a regulatory audit. That means we’re pausing new vendor pilots that aren’t tied to the audit for the time being.

Asha and I would still like to keep the conversation open, but we need to push any demo out until the audit is finished (likely mid-November). Could you mark this as on-hold and we’ll reach back out once we have the audit window locked?

Thanks for being flexible — this is purely a resourcing/timing shift, not a technical ‘no’.

Best,
Liam
Liam Porter | Director of Platform Engineering
VividHealth
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Liam Porter <liam.porter@vividhealth.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling a focused 30m demo - proposed times + agenda

Hi Liam — thanks for the clarity and the timeframe.

Totally understand — audits and migration work can absorb bandwidth quickly. We’ll put your demo on hold and remove the tentative slots from our calendar. A few notes so we’re aligned: 
- I’ll flag the HubSpot record (VID-2026-074) as ‘pilot-paused – prospect-priority-shift’ and note the expected revisit window (mid-November).
- Marissa, I’m removing the technical slot we’d held for 9/14; when Liam’s team is ready we can prioritize a 30m technical deep-dive + cost/latency review.
- Liam/Asha: if it helps before your audit, we can send a 1–page cost/latency snapshot tailored to your estimated volume so leadership has a figure to reference during planning — no live demo required. Would you prefer that?

We’ve attached the mutual action plan and agenda here for your audit packet if helpful. No pressure.

Thanks again — we’ll stand by and re-engage when you’re ready.

Warmly,
Aisha
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling a focused 30m demo - proposed times + agenda

Thanks for the note — I’ve updated the internal playbook and HubSpot stage.

Quick internal checklist:
- Mark deal VID-2026-074 as pilot_on_hold and set a task to follow up 2026-11-16.
- Save the demo agenda and mutual action plan to the VividHealth folder (link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1VividHealthPilotDocs).
- Sean: hold the prepped runbook for a technical deep-dive in case they want a short 15m pre-brief before the demo.

We’ll also prepare that 1-page snapshot Aisha offered unless Liam asks us not to. Target: send the snapshot by 9/17 so they have numbers for planning.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
